subject: Re: Encord - questions for commercial proposal
text:
Hi James. This is how we currently think about these questions:

Expected number of users for the forthcoming 12+ months: Here we would like to explore 3 options that would make sense for us:

  *   Minimal: 10 users. This seems like the minimal setup for us in which we can still do useful work.
  *   Comfort: 20 users. Here we would be less constrained in the number of users, allowing for some additional use cases to be put onto the platform.
  *   Maxed-out: 50 users. Here we could put each and every use case onto the platform with sufficient redundancy.

More information about our current labeling setup: annotation volumes, and language requirements.

  *   Total expected labeling per year: 5’000h
  *   EU-only & language specific (DE/FR/IT/ES): ~2’000h
  *   Language-specific (DE/FR/IT/ES): ~500h (Part Action Pair & Line Item Classification)
  *   English to be added at some point

Cheers,
Georg

subject: Encord proposal
text:
Hi James,

Thank you for your time yesterday and for having shared the updated proposal with us.

After internal checks, here are our comments:

• 

We are interested in the 'Annotate only' solution

• 

We understand that the GPU won't be relevant in this case and that pricing will be based only on the number of seats (please confirm)

• 

We would like to start with 20 users and a 1-year commitment, in case the POC proves to be successful

• 

We need confirmation that the seats can be reassigned (rotation of annotators is quite common in our projects)

• 

We would ask that the POC cost is discounted from the one-year total commitment

• 

According to your offer, you are applying an approximate 10–15% discount on the full platform option, and we would like to retain the same discount for the 'annotate only' option as well.

That said, we would like to receive an offer in the $25k–$30k range, including the unit price for extra seats. I understand this is much less than what you have discussed with the Engineering team so far, but we would like to start the collaboration with a reduced number of seats that might potentially grow over the contract term.

Considering the POC is ongoing, once you send the updated proposal we’ll review it promptly and get back to you with any feedback.

Regards,

Ilaria

Thanks again, and looking forward to your thoughts.

Best,
